title: secale cereale subsp. vavilovii
intro: Secale cereale subsp. vavilovii, commonly known as Vavilov's wild rye, is a subspecies of the rye plant (Secale cereale) and a wild relative of bread rye. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Vavilov's wild rye include its potential to act as an immunomodulator, modulating the immune system and preventing or treating conditions such as autoimmune disorders and infections. The bioactive constituents of Secale cereale subsp. vavilovii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
